items.title: Hilda Taylor Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: My dad used to play with Arnold DePass.

ctx.x: Peter DePass, would he be, uh... Peter DePass. Oh, that's no relation to... D-E-P-S-S. It's D-E-P-S. It's D-E-P-S. It's no relation to Arnold DePass. No. He's the drummer Arnold DePass. Arnold DePass was a drummer drummer.
My dad used to play with Arnold DePass.
